# 知乎 (Zhihu)

> > China's leading question-and-answer platform featuring curated daily digests, live lectures, and knowledge-sharing across diverse topics from technology to humanities.

Zhihu serves as China's premier knowledge-sharing community, offering Q&A content, live sessions (知乎 Live), and daily compilations (知乎日报). The platform covers topics ranging from programming and quantitative trading to cultural discussions and historical insights.

## Key Topics

- 知乎 Live (Zhihu Live lectures)
- 知乎日报 (Zhihu Daily digest)
- Knowledge sharing and Q&A
- Python programming and development
- Quantitative trading and vn.py framework
- Self-learning programming
- Algorithmic trading strategies
- Open-source software development
- Mobile reading platform
- Chinese culture and history
- Software engineering education
- CTA trading strategies
- Community-driven content curation

## Daily Digest & Core Platform

- [知乎日报 - 每天 3 次，每次 7 分钟](https://daily.zhihu.com/?k=compilation&top): Zhihu Daily: curated high-quality content compilation platform delivering knowledge three times daily

## Programming & Technology Live Sessions

- [如何自学编程？ - 知乎 Live](https://www.zhihu.com/lives/860490807847841792): Live session on self-learning programming methodology and career tips
- [vn.py的过去、现在和将来 - 知乎 Live](https://www.zhihu.com/lives/863030558513573888): Live lecture on vn.py Python quantitative trading framework evolution and future development
